rite.prompt: Which Egyptian circular zodiac does Hall interpret?

signal:
ZODIAC.NFO                                          HALL 1.3
================================================================
The Zodiac and Its Signs
Manly P. Hall · 1928 · folio p.146 · ECHO SOLAR.ZOD

THESIS
  The belt of living signs is a clock for world-ages, not a newspaper horoscope.

POINTS
  * Primitive astronomical instruments
  * Equinoxes and solstices
  * Astrological ages
  * Circular zodiac of Tentyra (Dendera)
  * Horoscope of the world

SEE ALSO  sun  bembine  tarot  pythagorean-math
DEGREE    NEOPHYTE may read this screen
================================================================
translation: Hall wants the zodiac back from the fairground. Equinoxes and solstices are the hinges of the year; the signs are a language for those hinges. The Dendera circular zodiac is his exhibit: a stone clock. 'Ages of the world' means precession, not personality quizzes. The 'horoscope of the world' is the claim that history itself is a natal chart. Later tarot and the Tree will steal from this same belt of twelve.
